doc.brief: The kind of widget that can be added to a `GtkListBox`.
doc.md:
The kind of widget that can be added to a `GtkListBox`.

[`ListBox`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListBox) will automatically wrap its children in a `GtkListboxRow`
when necessary.

changed.brief: Marks `row` as changed, causing any state that depends on this to be updated.
changed.md:
Marks `row` as changed, causing any state that depends on this
to be updated.

This affects sorting, filtering and headers.

Note that calls to this method must be in sync with the data
used for the row functions. For instance, if the list is
mirroring some external data set, and *two* rows changed in the
external data set then when you call gtk_list_box_row_changed()
on the first row the sort function must only read the new data
for the first of the two changed rows, otherwise the resorting
of the rows will be wrong.

This generally means that if you don’t fully control the data
model you have to duplicate the data that affects the listbox
row functions into the row widgets themselves. Another alternative
is to call [`ListBox.invalidate_sort()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListBox#method:invalidate_sort) on any model change,
but that is more expensive.

get_activatable.brief: Gets whether the row is activatable.
get_activatable.md: Gets whether the row is activatable.

get_header.brief: Returns the current header of the `row`.
get_header.md:
Returns the current header of the `row`.

This can be used
in a [`ListBoxUpdateHeaderFunc`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListBoxUpdateHeaderFunc) to see if
there is a header set already, and if so to update
the state of it.

get_index.brief: Gets the current index of the `row` in its `GtkListBox` container.
get_index.md: Gets the current index of the `row` in its `GtkListBox` container.

get_selectable.brief: Gets whether the row can be selected.
get_selectable.md: Gets whether the row can be selected.

is_selected.brief: Returns whether the child is currently selected in its `GtkListBox` container.
is_selected.md:
Returns whether the child is currently selected in its
`GtkListBox` container.

set_activatable.brief: Set whether the row is activatable.
set_activatable.md: Set whether the row is activatable.

set_header.brief: Sets the current header of the `row`.
set_header.md:
Sets the current header of the `row`.

This is only allowed to be called
from a [`ListBoxUpdateHeaderFunc`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListBoxUpdateHeaderFunc).
It will replace any existing header in the row,
and be shown in front of the row in the listbox.

set_selectable.brief: Set whether the row can be selected.
set_selectable.md: Set whether the row can be selected.

activatable.brief: Determines whether the ::row-activated signal will be emitted for this row.
activatable.md:
Determines whether the ::row-activated
signal will be emitted for this row.

selectable.brief: Determines whether this row can be selected.
selectable.md: Determines whether this row can be selected.

activate.brief: This is a keybinding signal, which will cause this row to be activated.
activate.md:
This is a keybinding signal, which will cause this row to be activated.

If you want to be notified when the user activates a row (by key or not),
use the [`ListBox::row-activated`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ListBox#event:row-activated) signal on the row’s parent
`GtkListBox`.
